attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"hit the Wailing Moth country last week","reason":"Timing copied from an earlier bulletin; the briefing gives no date for the blizzard now."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It copies the briefing's section headings into the bulletin, which breaks character, and it restates old news (the closed passes and the raiders) at length rather than briefly. There is no trace of Tomas Quell's earnest, worried voice; the lost caravan is stated flatly with no reporting colour."}
